Subject: Thanks for the demo — next steps & budget owner intro

Hi Samir —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our end and suggested next steps so we can keep momentum: 

- Key pain: unpredictable inference costs for nightly batch jobs, and latency spikes during peak trading hours.
- Success criteria you shared: 95th percentile latency < 150ms for live queries, and predictable monthly spend within a committed cap.
- Technical constraints: on-premise models for PII workloads; procurement will want SOC2 + network architecture details.

Three asks from us to move this forward:
1) Intro to the economic buyer / budget owner who will sign off on a Reserved Capacity commitment (you mentioned someone on the infra side).
2) A short session with your procurement/security team to cover SOC2, data flow, and required evidence (we can share a tailored packet).
3) Proposed timeline: alignment call next week (30 min) to confirm stakeholders and timing for a pilot.

I’ve attached a short RFI template that answers the common procurement questions — happy to pre-fill anything to save your team time.

Would you be able to introduce me to Priya Desai (or the appropriate budget owner) and suggest 2×30 min windows next week?

Best,
Marissa Cole
